decisions.reason: A core piqué upholstery fabric with its own product page, close to the established offer, likely meets aspiration levels and gives no reason for problemistic search.

The wool-blend double-face fabric is only mentioned on the website and its blend conflicts somewhat with the recyclability goal, but its results are still uncertain and slack from the 2024 withdrawals lets the firm carry it another year.
The wool bouclé leno fits the firm's design tradition and its shift to renewable materials, and with industry growth there is no clear shortfall that calls for redirecting its resources.
Launched in 2024 and presented on its own page, the braided fabric is too new to judge against aspiration and has visible support, so it is kept.
